title: Default Top Perspective Two Window Layout
description: Make puzzle 3d and aggregator use a two-window layout by default: Top (left 1/3), Perspective (right 2/3). Honor instanceId and templateId from app default layouts so each pane seeds the correct projection.
summary:
Root cause of Top still being too zoomed in: WorldProjectionRig used R3F's bare `<orthographicCamera>` (unit frustum -1..1) while framing math assumed drei's pixel-sized frustum (left=-width/2). Zoom values that should fit a 50-unit reference only showed ~0.3 world units.

Switched parallel-family cameras in WorldProjectionRig and WorldOrbitCameraViewRig to drei OrthographicCamera (pixel frustum). WorldProjectionContentFrame now also writes left/right/top/bottom/zoom onto the live OrthographicCamera. Padding raised to 1.35.

Tests: infinite-world-r3f 100/100, framework-renderer-react 205/205.
